Job Description
 We are seeking an Advanced Cloud Platform Engineer with HPC expertise to join our team. Primary responsibilities will focus on the operations and maintenance of high-performance computing (HPC) platforms, alongside providing user support. The role may also involve design and development of analytical computing platforms.
 Main Responsibilities:
Operation and administration of SLURM (HPC scheduler) and Linux (Ubuntu) clusters, guiding users on job submissions and administrative tasks.
Troubleshooting job execution issues for users.
System and cluster monitoring, alert management, and operational setup optimization.
Definition, documentation, and building of releases and patches, which includes documenting operations instructions.
Debugging Python and R scripts as needed.
Acting as a sparring partner to understand user challenges and contribute ideas for future development.
Expertise in AWS services (pcluster), HPC Isilon clusters, application installation/hosting, and integration with various data sources.
 Key Requirements:
High-performance computing cluster building and administration.
AWS services experience.
Proficiency with Slurm scheduler.
Linux (Ubuntu) and Windows competency.
Application installation knowledge.
Experience with Run:ai, Python, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Ansible, and DevSecOps methodologies.
Operations and maintenance management experience.
Higher education degree in engineering, computer science, or a similar field.
A minimum of 5 years experience in the field.
 Nice to Have:
Strong teamwork and focus on quality processes and task management methodologies.
